title: Paper Moon retail ledger integration - raw ramble
summary: Capture of kickoff call + early technical probe for Paper Moon (mid-market retail chain) who want ledger reconciliation and conversational receipts assistant in a private deployment.
background: Paper Moon runs ~240 stores, mixed POS vendors. Goal: server-side assistant that ingests store receipts and maps to canonical ledger entries (SKU mapping, tax handling), plus an agent to answer cashier/operator queries. Must be private/VPC; cannot send PII to hosted API. They want soft real-time: human-facing answers within ~200ms p95 when used at POS. Budget-conscious — looking to avoid expensive per-token hosted pricing; prefer Redwood Private with a small dedicated cluster initially.
primary_asks: Canonicalize receipts -> ledger entries (mapping to existing SKU catalog)
Conversational receipts assistant for cashiers with context window across last 30 transactions
Private deployment (VPC) with KMS + audit logs
Predictable latency target: p95 <= 200ms for short queries
nonfunctional_constraints: No external egress for raw receipt text (PHI/PII risk)
Audit logs retained 1 year per their compliance team
Key material must be in their KMS/HSM - Redwood must integrate; no customer keys stored in hosted control plane
Ability to scale during end-of-day surges (batch reconciliation) but keep low-latency path for cashier queries
technical_requirements: Private control plane with VPC peering or VPN (they prefer peering)
Model pinning and two variants: small fast model for cashier Qs, larger for heavy reconciliation jobs
KV/prefix caching for recent receipts per-store to reduce tokens
Embeddings index for historical search (local vector DB inside private deployment)
Integration hooks to two POS vendors via SFTP push and a webhook connector (they'll provide sample dumps)
KMS integration: AWS KMS + optional HSM for signing
gotchas: Receipts are often OCR'd by third-party scanners and include garbage lines. Need normalization pipeline before model input.
Long concatenated receipts blow up seq length — must chunk intelligently or summarize locally before sending to model.
Cashier UI expects single-turn latencies; batching helps costs but increases latency — need separate fast pathway.
POS vendor A returns base64 blobs for images which delays pipeline; recommend an async preprocessor.
They have an internal SKU catalog with fuzzy names (lots of synonyms) — reconciliation accuracy relies heavily on a mapping table and few-shot examples.
Audit + retention policy will inflate storage/observability costs; surface to finance early.
notes_from_call: David: strict networking - no public subnets for processing nodes; prefer private deploy in us-west-2.
Aisha: end-of-day reconciliation can be deferred (minutes) but cashier queries must be instant.
Marcus (RSE): wants a test dataset w/ 72 sample OCR receipts & edge cases (handwritten totals, split payments).
Elena: propose 2-model strategy: quantized Llama 2 13B-int8 for fast path, 70B fp16 on Dedicated for heavy reconciliation (batch).
We discussed caching recent receipts per store for 7 days vs full index for 90 days.
Discussed failure modes: model fallback to template-based parser when latency spikes.

Marcus: spin up a private eval cluster stub in staging and share access (ETA 2025-11-14)
David: confirm VPC CIDR ranges and KMS admin contact by next week
Elena: prepare model-cost comparison (int8 vs fp16) with estimated token counts by 2025-11-13
Open JIRA JIRA-1428: ingestion normalization pipeline (assigned to Marcus)
Schedule follow-up tech deep-dive (60m) with Paper Moon infra + Redwood infra week of 2025-11-17
open_questions: How many concurrent cashier sessions per store during peak? (they estimated 6-8 but need clarity)
Do they require receipts images to be retained or can we discard after structured extraction?
Can POS vendors push normalized CSV instead of raw OCR? Need commitment from Paper Moon product.
Are there regulatory requirements in their operating states about egress of aggregated telemetry?
quick_config_sketch: Private deployment: 3-node dedicated GPU pool (NVIDIA T4s or A10s?) for fast path model (13B int8) with autoscale to 5 nodes for batch windows. Separate batch workers on larger cards (A100s) behind a scheduled job for nightly reconciliation. VPC peering -> private control plane; KMS via IAM role; local vector DB (faiss) on EBS encrypted volumes. Suggest sticky routing by store ID to reuse KV cache and reduce cold-starts.
raw_jottings: random heuristics: treat lines with $ and digits as totals; if OCR confidence < 0.6, route to strict parser; nag vendor A about sending raw images only when requested; consider lightweight local seq2seq summarizer (on device) to trim long receipts before model request.
privacy_notes: PII fields to redact pre-send (card last4 only allowed), customer names must be hashed. Audit trail: redact full content from logs but keep structured metadata and hashes for troubleshooting.
